delta.note: 29 added tests: ProductionConfigSafetyTest (16), WalletWriteContractTest (9), QueueDispatchContractTest (4). All passing.

status: STILL FAILING -- the suite is not green. This is reported as-is. No test was weakened, skipped, marked incomplete or deleted to improve this number.

largest_single_cause_resolved.cause: Vite manifest not found at public/build/manifest.json
largest_single_cause_resolved.explanation: Front-end assets had never been compiled. Every feature test rendering a Blade view that extends the asset layout aborted during view render, before reaching any assertion. The real application-logic failure count was masked by a build gap.
largest_single_cause_resolved.fix: npm ci && npm run build -- 142 packages, 0 vulnerabilities, 28 entrypoints emitted to public/build/.

remaining_failures_classified.symptom: The route returns 200 and renders a full HTML document, but the document does not contain the string the test demands (prize status badges, lane parity blocks, DB-backed stat panels, countdown placeholders such as TBA).
remaining_failures_classified.assessment: Genuine unimplemented or partially implemented marketing/public-surface features. These are the 'marketing and hosting integration gaps' class, not the five production blockers. Each needs individual feature work against its own acceptance test.

remaining_failures_classified.symptom: A named route is generated without a parameter it declares as required.
remaining_failures_classified.assessment: Real routing defects on verification and lane pages. Separate from the five blockers.
Fixture/seed expectations in lane tests that do not match what the lane services create. Needs per-lane investigation.
Type contract violations in aggregate 'whole system' suites. Real defects requiring individual diagnosis.

remaining_failures_classified.symptom: 'The selected method is invalid' on deposit and withdrawal -- no payment methods are configured or seeded in the testing environment -- plus a dashboard copy assertion on 'TBA'.
remaining_failures_classified.assessment: Configuration/seed gap plus copy gap. NOT the Phase 2 mass-assignment defect, which is closed: zero MassAssignmentException remain in the final run.

blocker_specific_verification.remaining_mass_assignment_sites: User.kyc_status and GloL6Sale.created_at -- NOT Wallet. Reported open below.
blocker_specific_verification.production_safety_suite: 29 passed across 3 new release-blocking test classes

integrity_statement: No test was modified, skipped, weakened or deleted to reach this result. No Pint exclusion was added and no pint.json exists. Where a test was found to be written against a non-existent API, that was reported as a test defect rather than fixed by loosening production code.

newly_found_and_fixed_this_pass.found_by: BusinessCriticalInvariantTest invariant 1 + FinalProductionReadinessTest check 6, both dying with BindingResolutionException
newly_found_and_fixed_this_pass.impact: Webhook replay protection -- the single most important money-safety property in the system -- was never actually verified by anything, because the class the tests exercised was absent.
newly_found_and_fixed_this_pass.fix: Created the service plus App\DTOs\Payment\WebhookProcessingResult. Idempotency is enforced by the UNIQUE index on financial_transactions.idempotency_key inside the crediting transaction, and a lost race on that index is correctly reported as a replay rather than an error.

newly_found_and_fixed_this_pass.impact: getOrCreateWallet() declares int|User, so PHP resolved the bare User to App\Services\Finance\User, which does not exist. Passing a real User model always raised a TypeError; only the int branch was reachable.

newly_found_and_fixed_this_pass.defect: Two classes named WalletService with divergent credit()/debit() signatures
newly_found_and_fixed_this_pass.impact: Finance\WalletService accepted only Money and only the enum; Wallet\WalletService accepted Money|string and string|enum and delegated to it. The same call succeeded or raised a TypeError depending on which use statement was at the top of the caller's file.
newly_found_and_fixed_this_pass.fix: Canonical service widened to match the facade. Unrecognised type strings fall back to the method default rather than silently mis-labelling a ledger entry.

remaining_failures_open.symptom: Route returns 200 with a full HTML document, but the document lacks the demanded string (prize status badges, lane parity blocks, DB-backed stat panels, TBA countdown placeholders).
remaining_failures_open.assessment: Genuine unimplemented marketing-surface features. Each needs individual feature work against its own acceptance test.

Several are tests written against APIs that do not exist in any form -- e.g. P0P1P2ComprehensiveEnterpriseSuiteTest calls credit() with a string as the 5th argument where the parameter is array $options. Those are test-side defects and were NOT papered over by changing the tests.
Lane fixture/seed expectations do not match what the lane services create.
Named routes generated without required parameters -- real routing defects on verification and lane pages.

remaining_failures_open.detail: User.kyc_status has a cast but is absent from $fillable, and GloL6Sale.created_at is not fillable. kyc_status was deliberately NOT added to $fillable: tests/Feature/Compliance/WithdrawalKycGateTest.php:133 is a forgery test proving the system must never accept kyc_status from request input. The correct fix is a factory state or an explicit service writer, not a wider mass-assignment surface.
remaining_failures_open.assessment: OPEN by design decision, documented rather than silently widened.
